The large remeasure deltas record first-pass eye estimates taken from rescaled image renders whose displayed-pixel positions were systematically off (worst case: sheet 10 east face first placed at ~4470 from a mislocated render read); the escalation diagnosis is rendering parallax in the reading environment, not plate ambiguity - every final number is a profile-confirmed tick-relative read whose placement was re-verified visually on the annotated evidence crop, and the drafted-width and shift-consistency checks close (416-418 px vs printed 70', shifts within 2 px of Ave D's). No plate disagreement at this anchor.
